phase: implementation contract; no official process invoked

agent_extension_capabilities.selection: Same RAM exact AgentRow ticket authorizes either supported kind; 300 seconds non-sliding, bounded64, no env hash/disclosure.

operation.correlation: kind is mandatory in every operation; ready must have matching snapshot/source/scope; non-ready has no snapshot. cancel(null) has no kind because it is a before-dispatch tombstone, never historic exit proof.
operation.idempotence: One request UUID binds agent/cwd/selectionId/kind. Changing kind is requestConflict. Same Agent across both kinds shares one unfinished slot; global active maximum2, retention64/300s, active never evicted. status/cancel never require a nonexpired selection ticket.

snapshots.mcp: Existing McpInventory fields/values are unchanged; operation adds kind=mcp.

skills.errorCount: integer0..512; count of official per-cwd errors, no raw error/path/message

SkillInventoryItem.name: safe plain label string|null; <=256 UTF8 bytes, same allowed label policy as MCP. null must show name unavailable, not omit the row.
SkillInventoryItem.description: string|null; prefer interface.shortDescription, then shortDescription, then description; whitespace-only => null. Plain text only, never command/prompt/HTML/Markdown execution.
SkillInventoryItem.descriptionTruncated: boolean; visible output clipped to <=2048 Unicode scalar values AND <=8192 UTF8 bytes. UI must disclose truncation.
SkillInventoryItem.descriptionRedacted: boolean; control/format characters and detectable URI/path/credential-like tokens removed or replaced. UI can state filtered. No promise that arbitrary prose has been proven secret-free.
SkillInventoryItem.pluginReported: boolean only; no raw plugin ID/path

privacy: Never forward raw skill/error paths, init codexHome/userAgent metadata, error.data/message, stderr, plugin identifiers, dependencies command/URL, icons/defaultPrompt or unknown fields. Bounded descriptions are user-facing metadata only: not logs/diagnostics, persisted inventory, or automatically appended to any draft.
readSemantics: Exact one selected canonical cwd supplied in process cwd and skills/list cwds. Same skill name from multiple reported paths/scopes remains multiple rows. Nonempty errors plus zero skills is partial/error, not empty success. Official reported inventory is not proof current running conversation loaded/uses it; source scope is not a writable configuration layer.
process: Exact reviewed Node/adapter CLI relay app-server --listen stdio://; initialize fixed clientInfo(no experimental/attestation opt-in), initialized, skills/list(cwds:[exact],forceReload:true), then stdin EOF. Fixed methods only, no thread/turn/write/config/auth calls. Same actual group/reap/pipe cleanup and observer ownership. Ordinary official startup may maintain its own state/cache/config-derived resources; not zero-write.

limits.scope: Entire query including handshake; exceeding budget fails, never truncated complete JSON. Notifications count against byte budget. Existing TERM then2s KILL,7s pendingCleanup observer, actual worker remains owner until cleanup.

busy: Skills additionally acquires existing AccountScope for selected program/registered aliases; no live or uncertain same-program work admitted, and no forced retirement of existing connections. Hold until actual cleanup. MCP existing behavior remains unchanged; external processes are not claimed globally locked.
boundaries: Explicit query only; choice of kind/Agent/directory does not start CLI.
Agent-specific launch and official schema logic stay acp_client. No new dependency/environment flag/private HOME or upstream patch.
Official installed query will be performed by root later; controlled tests and actual Rust serialization are separate evidence.
